svg.title: The power rule seen as slopes
svg.desc: Top: the graph of f(x) = x cubed with short tangent segments at x = minus 1.4, minus 0.7, 0, 0.7 and 1.4. Bottom, on the same x scale: the graph of f prime of x = 3x squared, with dots at heights 5.88, 1.47, 0, 1.47 and 5.88, the slopes of those tangent lines. The slope is 0 at x = 0 and the same at x and minus x.
svg.text: of the tangent line above it:
